problem: John has 3 apples. Mary has 5 more apples than John. How many apples does Mary have?
smtlib:
(declare-const j Int)
(declare-const m Int)
(assert (= j 3))
(assert (= m (+ j 5)))
(check-sat)
(get-value (m))
label: solvable

problem: A store has some books. They sold 12 books and now have 30 books. How many books did they start with?
smtlib:
(declare-const start Int)
(declare-const sold Int)
(declare-const remaining Int)
(assert (= sold 12))
(assert (= remaining 30))
(assert (= start (+ sold remaining)))
(check-sat)
(get-value (start))
label: solvable

problem: Tom has twice as many marbles as Jane. Tom has 14 marbles. How many marbles does Jane have?
smtlib:
(declare-const tom Int)
(declare-const jane Int)
(assert (= tom 14))
(assert (= tom (* 2 jane)))
(check-sat)
(get-value (jane))
label: solvable

problem: A box contains 20 chocolates. After eating some, 8 remain. How many were eaten? (Note: the problem also states 15 were eaten.)
smtlib:
(declare-const total Int)
(declare-const eaten Int)
(declare-const remaining Int)
(assert (= total 20))
(assert (= remaining 8))
(assert (= eaten (- total remaining)))
(assert (= eaten 15))
(check-sat)
(get-value (eaten))
label: contra

problem: Sarah has 10 dollars and spends 12 dollars. How much does she have left?
smtlib:
(declare-const start Int)
(declare-const spent Int)
(declare-const left Int)
(assert (= start 10))
(assert (= spent 12))
(assert (>= left 0))
(assert (= left (- start spent)))
(check-sat)
(get-value (left))
label: contra

problem: If 3 pencils cost 6 dollars, how much do 7 pencils cost?
smtlib:
(declare-const unit_price Real)
(declare-const total Real)
(assert (= (* 3 unit_price) 6))
(assert (= total (* 7 unit_price)))
(check-sat)
(get-value (total))
label: solvable

problem: A triangle has all three angles equal. The first angle is 50 degrees and the second is 80 degrees. What is the third?
smtlib:
(declare-const a1 Real)
(declare-const a2 Real)
(declare-const a3 Real)
(assert (= a1 50))
(assert (= a2 80))
(assert (= a1 a2))
(assert (= a2 a3))
(assert (= (+ a1 a2 a3) 180))
(check-sat)
(get-value (a3))
label: contra
